1.0.9: [Improved] Update Electron, the runtime Lodestone is built on, from 44.9.1 to 44.11.4: Chromium and V8 security fixes, Node.js 24.22.3, and certificates of revoked eMudhra intermediates are no longer trusted
1.0.8: [Fixed] Files that Windows runs, installs, mounts or starts a program with (scripts, shortcuts, installers, disk images and every other type on Microsoft's list of blocked Outlook attachments) are no longer opened with the program Windows has for them; Lodestone shows a message instead, and the file can still be shown in its folder
[Fixed] Email avatars of a Gitea or Forgejo instance under a sub path are requested from that sub path, not from the root of the host

[New] A repository that brings its own Git configuration or hooks asks first: the question lists the commands, keys and hooks it would run, and the default answer is not to trust it. An untrusted repository runs Git with those commands switched off and hooks disabled; if it also changes how Git connects, it gets no network operations. Revoke a decision in Settings, Advanced

[Improved] Git runs with the file system monitor off for status, with external diff and text conversion off for diff, log and show, and refuses bare repositories and repositories whose configuration moves the working folder elsewhere
1.0.7: [Improved] The accent colour of links and the mark has more contrast on the deep surface in both themes

[Fixed] Branch, remote and file names that start with a dash or hold characters Git treats specially are passed to Git as names, not as options or patterns, in every Git operation of the app (ported from GitHub Desktop)
[Fixed] Cloning from a local path in quotes or a Windows file address, and the clone transport policy, follow Git's own rules
[Fixed] A crash when reading Git LFS progress, repeated branch name checks that gave different answers, and ignore file rules written for paths with special characters
[Improved] Open a file with the program Windows has for it by its path, not through a file address
1.0.6: [Fixed] Open only web addresses (http and https) in the browser, whichever link or host they come from
1.0.5: [Fixed] Create issue on the host did nothing for a repository whose web address the app had not stored yet; it now opens the new issue page, and the menu names GitHub for github.com instead of "the server"
1.0.4: [Improved] Update Electron, the runtime Lodestone is built on, from 42 to 44.9.1; version 42 gets no more security fixes
[Fixed] Windows: the title bar of the window stays responsive after the Electron update
1.0.3: [Improved] Update itself only to a newer version, decided by the app, and read the release from github.com itself instead of taking the list of files from the window
[Fixed] Keep memory use low while an update downloads to a slow disk
[Fixed] A second update request no longer empties the folder Squirrel is still reading
[Improved] Keep the log files in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Lodestone\logs on Windows, so a roaming profile does not carry them
[Improved] Support long paths on Windows, where long paths are enabled
1.0.2: [New] Update itself on Windows from the repository set in Options, once the package matches the SHA-256 the release lists for it
[Security] Mask passwords and tokens in the log, such as credentials in a clone URL or an Authorization header (GHSA-gmvh-p668-gr4c)
[Improved] Name Celestial0579 as the publisher on Windows, and move the Start menu shortcut there on update without leaving the old one behind
1.0.1: [Fixed] Check for updates on GitHub, where the project moved, and say so when a check fails or finds nothing published
[New] Announce a newer release in the main window, with a link to it
[Fixed] Finish an installation cut short on its first start, and take shortcuts, the command line tool and stored credentials back on uninstall
[Fixed] Tell a current Gitea from Forgejo, and match instances whose address has a port
[Fixed] Name the host in menu items instead of always saying Gitea, and call the settings dialog Options on Windows
[Fixed] Run hooks with PowerShell 7 installed from winget, and with an apostrophe in the temp path
[Fixed] Stop asking Gitea and Forgejo for GitHub's feature flags and Copilot on every account refresh
[Security] Update Electron to 42.11.16 and take the patched releases of dependencies with open advisories
1.0.0: [New] Sign in to any Gitea instance with a personal access token
[New] Talk to the Gitea REST API (/api/v1) instead of the GitHub API
[Removed] GitHub.com, Copilot, and usage reporting to GitHub
